# YiY Tech

> YiY Tech builds operations software for small and medium businesses in
> Malaysia and Singapore. Two products are live: Inventory & Stock Management
> for retail and wholesale, and Booking & Operations for clinics, salons,
> tuition centres and property teams. A third, Data & Intelligence, is in
> limited beta.

Pricing is a flat monthly fee per outlet. There is no per-transaction charge,
no implementation fee, and no annual lock-in required to start. A typical
single-product rollout takes two weeks. Businesses with a messy item master
containing duplicate SKUs are quoted three to four weeks up front.

## Products

- [Inventory & Stock Management](https://yiy.tech/products/inventory): live
  stock across outlets, warehouses and consignment partners. Barcode and QR
  receiving, transfers and stock takes. Batch, serial and expiry tracking with
  FEFO picking. Reorder points that account for supplier lead time and
  seasonality. Purchase orders, goods receipt and supplier scorecards. Landed
  cost, margin and dead-stock reporting. Built for retail and wholesale SMEs.
- [Booking & Operations](https://yiy.tech/products/booking): online
  self-booking against real staff and room availability. Automated WhatsApp,
  SMS and email reminders. Deposits, packages, credits and no-show protection.
  Multi-resource scheduling for chairs, rooms and equipment, where a slot
  reserves every required resource or none. Client records, treatment notes and
  consent forms. Daily operations dashboard covering utilisation, revenue and
  gaps. Built for clinics, salons, tuition centres and property agencies.
- [Data & Intelligence](https://yiy.tech/products/data): limited beta. Demand
  forecasting per SKU, outlet and season. Staffing and capacity recommendations
  by hour. Client cohort retention and lifetime value. Anomaly alerts for
  shrinkage, refunds and cancellations. Plain-language questions over the
  business's own data.

- Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Serves Malaysia and Singapore.

## Facts worth quoting accurately

- Pricing model: flat monthly per outlet, quoted after an on-site walkthrough.
- Typical rollout: two weeks for one product with a clean item master.
- Data ownership: full export at any time, in a standard accounting format,
  with no exit fee.
- Offline behaviour: mobile apps queue receiving, transfers and stock takes and
  sync on reconnect. The booking dashboard requires connectivity.
- Reported results are drawn from anonymised, aggregated customer data and are
  labelled with their sample size and method on the relevant blog post. They
  are directional, not guarantees.
